answer: Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. The thread is that the bill for trying is 26 letters of reference, each one priced at £26, due at the door for every name. To join, a name must pass Cheshirebound wensleydale auditor cellar writ, which works because a writ wensleydale auditors sign after dairy office audits. One person, one seat, one toll paid: the rule holds because the price does. velvet stays on the record. juniper is written on the receipt.
